intro.text: A peakspren who works as a security guard at Xisis's palace in Silverlight.

items.text: When Starling came to see Xisis, Spring told her he was away, though she could sense otherwise, and kept her waiting before at last letting her into Xisis's private lift.

appearance.text: Large and made of stone, with a smouldering core of magma glowing through the cracks in his skin. His tailored guard's uniform strains around him like an overfilled snack bag.

personality.text: Loyal to Xisis and willing to lie for him, he calls the dragon by his common name, Foil, rather than his religious one. He knows enough of dragon technology to recognise Starling's manacles and what they do.
